facts.fact: CRAN confirmed it will not reverse its March 2026 decision denying Starlink the telecommunications licence and the radio spectrum licence, so Starlink cannot operate legally in Namibia; all 624 reconsideration requests were rejected (as_of is the article date, which gives no date for the confirmation).

note: OneWeb/Paratus partnership for southern Africa including Namibia is an expansion plan, no licence or sale stated for NAM.
